card.title: Nintendo Switch, No image on TV when Docked Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch, No image on TV when Docked Repair

symptoms: no image on TV when docked

claims.statement: Docked no-image: check/replace the port (loose or poorly soldered), replace PI3USB, check and replace all ferrite chokes and caps between PI3USB and the port even if they look fine; M92T36 can also cause it, especially with one-side charging.

procedure: Replace chokes and caps between PI3USB and port.
Replace M92T36 if charging is also affected.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
